subject: U-CHAIN round 3: NO-GO posted, reports pushed
body: Posted the round-3 NO-GO review on PR #484 bound to ca616c77 and pushed report-only commit 1e2f099bfa02cf38ac6aa25bd9236bd0b8394d77 to ravidsrk/u-chain after validation and all 1707 tests passed.
